eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 7:25 PM on AUG 18, 2025 Effective until 3:25 AM AUG 19, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office has issued an EVACUATION ORDER for Zones 3306, 3310, 3311 in the area of KLAMATHON ROAD/ROOSTER DRIVE due to VEGETATION FIRE. Anyone in this area is ordered to leave now.
